mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, user_id, account_id, instrument_id, symbol, side, order_type, quantity, requested_price, executed_price, status, reject_reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{orderType}, #{quantity}, #{requestedPrice}, #{executedPrice}, #{status}, #{rejectReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, executed_price = #{executedPrice}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
